newLots.name: (株)かわむら
newLots.src: earth r3 (c4r3/kawamura top): southern, HIGHER slab plus the 9 m x 12 m west arm (the old 12 x 6.5 m 'NE plant block'): the step wall casts a 4.1 m N-S dark band (z_img -688.3..-683.7; half-contrast edges of the column profile, 7.3 px/m) onto the north slab: along bearing 340 that is 4.4 m, so with the calibrated 0.97 factor of EARTH_SCENE the step is about 4.3 m (a lean-corrected geometric model gives 3.5 m; the calibrated factor is the one tied to OSM-levelled blocks): 8.7 + 4.3 = 13.0 m. Step wall at true z -686.4 after removing the roof lean 0.21 x 13 m (the same lean puts the roof outline within 0.5 m of the GSI footprint on the north, south and east edges); polygon overlaps the north slab by 0.15 m so no wall is coplanar
